notes: pivot fails by +1.25 studs on Z, matching the pre-fix file exactly (Blender read of that FBX: object y=-1.25, world Y -3.5..1.0); the 1eee84a file has the object at the origin with world Y -2.25..2.25, Z 0..8

conclusions: Default FBX export (bkit.ops.export_fbx) plus Import 3D with Scale Unit = Stud maps 1 Blender unit to 1 stud and Blender -Y (front) to Roblox -Z: facing matched the mesh measurement for both revisions.
Studio sets an imported model's pivot at the FBX file origin, not at the object origin: assets must be exported with their origin at the world origin.
Per-material base colours do not survive Import 3D: colour needs a baked texture (or SurfaceAppearance) to carry over.
Import 3D uploads the mesh; there is no local-only import path.
